values.note: Loops A-D hold the 50-amp electric/water sites; E Loop takes tents or trailers under 20 ft and 2,500 lb dry, F Loop is tents only. Two camper cabins and a 60-person tent group site.

values.note: Anoka County WebTrac or 763-324-3300; 2027 reservations open March 1, 2027 at 8 a.m. No more than 7 reserved nights in any 30 days. Cancel 72 hours ahead for a refund less $8; changes $8. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out noon.

values.note: Anoka County Parks: 50-amp site $45 a night (every Rice Creek RV site is 50-amp electric/water); rustic $30 (tent loops), camper cabin $85, group site $100. Anoka or Washington County vehicle permit required. Read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.anokacountyparks.com/camping (rates: 'rustic sites $30 per night'; '30 amp sites $40 per night'; '50 amp sites $45 per night'; 'group campsite ... $100 per night - Rice Creek'; 'camper cabins $85 per night') + Rice Creek map legend (only 50-amp electric sites); rules ('All vehicles are required to have an Anoka or Washington County Vehicle Permit'), read 2026-11-11

note: Anoka County campground in the Rice Creek Chain of Lakes Park Reserve off Main Street in Centerville, shaded loops on a wooded rise, about 25 minutes from Minneapolis-St. Paul; beach, boat launch and Wargo Nature Center nearby. --Claude
summary: County camping page + Rice Creek map read: 57 sites (stored 58 was Bunker Hills'), RV sites all 50-amp electric/water, E Loop trailers under 20 ft, F Loop tents; showers, dump; 2026 season May 8-Sep 27; WebTrac, opens Mar 1 2027; 7 nights in 30; $45 (30-amp $40 is Bunker Hills only).
